questions.ask: How do I get to the venue?

evidence.text: Directions go to the street address printed with the date above, and to one per date on the dates page; the club keeps no door of its own, and this site drops no pin.
The address printed with a line is the address to give directions to, and no page here draws a route to it.

Every date names the place it is in and prints its street address, and that address is how you get there: the club meets in coffee shops, bakeries and breweries around the Twin Cities, so there is no single door this site could give directions to.
